faqs.q: How far in advance should I book my appointment?
faqs.a: We recommend booking 3 to 7 days in advance for peak weekend slots and balayage appointments. You can use our 24/7 instant online booking tool above to check live availability.

faqs.q: Do you offer complimentary consultations for color & styling?
faqs.a: Yes! Every color service starts with a detailed 15-minute consultation to analyze your hair health, skin undertones, and desired maintenance schedule.

faqs.q: What products do you use in your salon?
faqs.a: We exclusively use cruelty-free, luxury organic professional formulas including Olaplex bond repair, Davines botanicals, and medical-grade skincare serums.

faqs.q: What is your cancellation or rescheduling policy?
faqs.a: We understand plans change! We ask for at least 24 hours notice for standard appointments, and 48 hours for large multi-hour balayage or bridal packages.
